Procedure: 1. Navigate to Workflow Configuration. 2. Click 'Upload Data'. 3. Select a valid .fastq file. 4. Wait for upload to finish.

Procedure: 1. Select 'Import from Cloud Storage'. 2. Provide External Cloud credentials/link. 3. Select target genomic files. 4. Click 'Transfer'.

Procedure: 1. Navigate to Profile/Manage Datasets. 2. Click 'Delete' next to a file. 3. Confirm deletion in the pop-up. 4. Refresh page.
Expected Results: File is removed from the UI and from the underlying S3 storage.

Procedure: 1. Click 'Build Pipeline'. 2. Drag 'QC' component to canvas. 3. Drag 'Assembly' component and connect. 4. Click 'Save Pipeline'.
Expected Results: Workflow structure is saved and visible in 'Saved Pipelines' on Profile Page.

Procedure: 1. Select 'Configure' with automation. 2. Provide analysis goals. 3. Answer high-level questions. 4. Review proposed tools.
Expected Results: System automatically selects appropriate tools based on user answers.

Procedure: 1. Go to Workflow Configuration. 2. Select 'Tool A' from the list. 3. Select 'Tool B'. 4. Check parameter fields.
Expected Results: UI only shows parameters specific to Tool A and Tool B; unrelated parameters are hidden.

Procedure: 1. Configure a workflow. 2. Leave a required parameter empty. 3. Click 'Validate/Execute'. 4. Check error markers.
Expected Results: Validation fails; UI highlights missing field with a 'required' warning.

Procedure: 1. Finalize workflow config. 2. View Resource Estimation section. 3. Change the dataset size. 4. Observe the estimated time/price.
Expected Results: Estimated cost and time update dynamically based on the ML model's prediction.

Procedure: 1. View recommended Machine instance. 2. Open dropdown to select a different class. 3. Click 'Confirm Selection'.
Expected Results: Workflow is updated to run on the user-selected instance class.

Procedure: 1. Complete configuration. 2. Click 'Execute Pipeline'. 3. Navigate to 'Active Jobs'. 4. Verify job status is 'Queued/Running'.
Expected Results: Backend sends parameters to Nextflow; Nextflow initiates the pipeline on Kubernetes.

Procedure: 1. Start Job One. 2. Start Job Two as a different user. 3. Check Kubernetes API for namespaces. 4. Verify separate namespaces.

Procedure: 1. Simulate a transient pod failure. 2. Observe Nextflow logs. 3. Check retry count for the task.
Expected Results: Nextflow automatically retries the failed task according to the predefined retry policy.

Procedure: 1. Start a running job. 2. Navigate to Jobs Page. 3. Click 'Cancel Workflow'. 4. Confirm action.
Expected Results: Workflow stops; Kubernetes pods for that job are terminated; status changes to 'Cancelled'.

Procedure: 1. Run a workflow to completion. 2. Access the Kubernetes namespace/storage. 3. Verify presence of final outputs vs intermediate files.
Expected Results: Temporary/intermediate files are removed; only final tool outputs remain.

Procedure: 1. Start a job. 2. Stay on the Jobs Page. 3. Watch the progress bar/status. 4. Wait for step change.
Expected Results: Status updates from 'Working' to 'Completed' for each step in near-real-time via UI.

Procedure: 1. Navigate to Completed Jobs. 2. Click 'Download All Results'. 3. Open the downloaded .zip file. 4. Check contents.
Expected Results: Download is successful; archive contains all relevant output files.

Procedure: 1. Go to a completed job. 2. Click 'View Logs'. 3. Scroll through tool output. 4. Verify readability.
Expected Results: Full Nextflow and tool logs are accessible for debugging and transparency.

Procedure: 1. Click 'Quality Control Results' for a job. 2. Observe displayed diagrams. 3. Verify data axes/labels.
Expected Results: UI displays visual diagrams as shown in mock-ups.

Procedure: 1. Open a saved workflow. 2. Click 'Publish to Community'. 3. Enter metadata (tags, description). 4. Submit.

Procedure: 1. Select a workflow from Community. 2. Click 'Import Pipeline'. 3. Navigate to 'My Workflows'. 4. Check for the copy.

Procedure: 1. Open a community workflow detail. 2. Click 'Upvote'. 3. Refresh page. 4. Check vote count.

Procedure: 1. Navigate to Workflow Config. 2. Hover over a '?' icon next to a tool parameter. 3. Read the popup.

Procedure: 1. Open multiple tabs. 2. Initiate 5 different workflows simultaneously. 3. Monitor 'Active Jobs'.

Procedure: 1. During an upload, simulate a brief S3 connection loss. 2. Check if system retries. 3. Verify file integrity after reconnect.

Procedure: 1. Run a workflow. 2. Record results. 3. Re-run identical workflow with same dataset and parameters. 4. Compare outputs.

Procedure: 1. Inspect a 'Workflow Step'. 2. Check the Docker image tag. 3. Ensure it's not using 'latest'. 4. Run job.

Procedure: 1. Create a workflow. 2. Click 'Execute' without selecting any data. 3. Observe UI behavior.

Procedure: 1. Upload a 50GB genomic dataset. 2. Configure a workflow. 3. Initiate execution. 4. Monitor storage and pod status.
